Prabhākara(miśra)
most important among the commentators on Śābarabhāṣya; ref. to a. ‘guru’ an. hence his system of mīm. known a. ‘gurumata’; held to be a contemporary or pupil of Kumārila; on the relative priority of their dates see Proceed. AIOC. III. p.. 474-81 an. G. Jha, P. mīm. App. p.. 16-17; for controversial views about Śālikanātha a. his pupil see G. Jha, ibid. p. 34; [Page024-b] wrongly identified with Sukumāra, a. of Kṛṣṇavilāsakāvya. See NCC. IV. p. 360a.
--C. Bṛhatī or Nibandhana on Śābarabhāṣya.
Pt.. in 3 pts. Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 3. 1934.
--C. Vivaraṇa or Laghvī on Śābarabhāṣya. See JOR. Madras III. 1929, p.. 281-91.
For further references on Prabhākara see G. Jha, ibid. p.. 28-31; Intro. to Tattvabindu p.. 34-40; T. R. Chintamani, Works of Prabhākara, JOR. Madras III. 1929, p.. 281-91. Proceed. AIOC. V (1930) p.. 119-20. an. K. R. Pisharoti, IHQ. V (1929) p.. 676-92; Hiriyanna, Prābhākaras--Old an. New, JOR. Madras IV. 1931, p.. 99-108. See also under Kumārila Bhaṭṭa, NCC. IV. p.. 223b-224b.
For some articles on his views see Potter, Encycl. of Ind. Phil. I. p. 80.

Prabhācandra
resident of Dhārā; pupil of Māṇikyanandin, described in the Śravaṇabelgola inscriptions a. preceptor of Mūlasaṅghadeśīgaṇa an. a. a pupil of Padmanandi (Kundakunda).
On the basis of the colophon to his C. on Parīkṣāmukha he is taken to be a contemporary of Bhojadeva an. hence a. belonging to the 11th Cent. See BORI. D. XVIII. i. 66 (colophon: zrImadbhojadevarAjye zrImaddhArAnivAsinI …prabhAcandreNa paNDitena etc.). But he an. his work Nyāyakumudacandrodaya are mentioned by Jinasena in Ādipurāṇa (9th Cent.). Hence he is placed prior to 9th Cent. See Intro. p. xliii to edn. of Parīkṣāmukha, Sac. Bk.. of the Jainas XI. Lucknow, 1940. Contemporary of Pātrakesari. On Śāntarakṣita, Kamalaśīla an. Prabhācandra see Pathak, K. B., ABORI. XII. 1. p.. 80-3. [Page027-b]
See N. Premi, Jain Sāh. aur Itihās p.. 236. 290; Y. Mimamsak. Sam3skṛta Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās I. p.. 537-38; Viśvatattvaprakāśa Intro. p.. 79-80.
